sources.finding: Task-specific from-scratch latent models can use intermediate states;reported capacity effects depend strongly on width. Fine-tuned models may instead solve the task in their prefix representations. These are symbolic ProsQA experiments,including step-indexed node targets,not natural-text NTP efficiency evidence.
sources.local_implication: Do not infer a universal billion-parameter floor or equate nonzero gradients with useful iterative work. Our observed nearly constant proposals differ from this paper's token-commitment collapse. The paper does not justify importing synthetic task data under the current charter.

sources.finding: Random-initialization GPTNeoX models on generated graph-reachability tasks learn latent mechanisms that generalize to longer paths;comparators with similar training-range accuracy need not generalize similarly.
sources.local_implication: Useful latent computation is possible in small models in this task setting. It is not a result on natural source text or our compute-matched baseline. Content interventions and compositional transfer remain necessary;this reading admits no synthetic-data fit.
